name: workflow-toolbox
description: Agents-only shim of the workflow-toolbox plugin, loaded by the observe server into delegated (server-launched) SDK sessions so workflow-toolbox:* agentTypes resolve there despite settingSources: []. Byte-identity-mirrored from plugin/agents/ (launch-agents-identity gate). It ships no context-injecting surfaces and ONE guard hook — the verifier-CLI guard (referenced via ../bin from the parent plugin, no bin/ dir of its own), matcher-narrowed to the StructuredOutput tool AND self-scoped to the external cross-family verifier wrapper — so the wrapper CANNOT emit a self-answered verdict without a real CLI invocation in these delegated (Path B) runs (the context the self-answer burn was observed in, card #1825163461588419933), while EVERY OTHER agent (leaf/lean/etc.) runs effectively bare: the hook never even spawns except on a StructuredOutput call, and instantly no-ops for any non-wrapper agent. Not for interactive install — the full workflow-toolbox plugin already provides these agents + hooks.
